content: Supabase's canonical RBAC doc (custom-claims-and-role-based-access-control-rbac) demonstrates an authorize()/has_role()-style helper: SECURITY DEFINER, set search_path = '' (empty, forcing fully-qualified table refs inside the function body), created in the public schema but with EXECUTE revoked from public/anon/authenticated and granted only to the roles that need it; RLS policies call it wrapped in a SELECT subquery: using ((select public.has_role('coordenador_geral'))).
